FN-HGRWS36-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 44
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/13/2025
House Bill 44 as introduced would allow the employees of the St. Clair County DAY Program,
Incorporated to participate in the Teacher's Retirement System, provided the program must pay
all costs necessary to fund the provisions of this bill, as determined by the TRS actuary. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-HGRWS36-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 44
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 03/25/2025
House Bill 44 as passed by the House of Representatives would allow the employees of the St.
Clair County DAY Program, Incorporated to participate in the Teacher's Retirement System,
provided the program pay all costs necessary to fund the provisions of this bill, as determined by
the TRS actuary. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
